notes:
Context: Argentum Diagnostics is a HIPAA-adjacent medical device company building a provider-facing clinical assistant. Primary ask: dedicated capacity with deterministic latency for short-turnaround clinical notes and triage. They sent sample traffic w/ median request 150 tokens, 95th percentile 900 tokens; heavy skew at morning shift. Key constraints: PHI -> on-prem/VPC preferred, strict data residency, legal wants explicit audit logs and KMS integration.

Workshop summary (02-18): captured baseline QPS = 120 steady, peaks up to 360 for 15-40 minute windows (3x/day). Target latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms for 8k token/sec aggregate? (customer used different phrasing). Liam ran quick back-of-envelope: with current model family (open LLM-opt-6.7B quantized) we estimate sustained throughput per GPU ~200 tokens/sec for live latency-sensitive paths using continuous-batching and small KV cache window. Initial sizing recommendation: reserve 10 GPUs with 20% headroom for autoscale bursts; set routing policy to prefer on-premdedicated then fallback to private-cloud dedicated in DR.

Customer quotes: 'we need guarantees — not just best-effort' ; 'if you can't show baseline token/sec profiling we'll push procurement back'.

Open items: define accepted SLOs for p50/p95/p99, capture exact peak-pattern CSV for Friday morning, produce hardware SKU list and SLA language for legal to review. Also need a short runbook for how Redwood fallback to hosted reduces PHI exposure (customer skeptical).
deal_notes: Procurement timeline: target Q2 close if security sign-off by mid-May. Preference for annual reserved contract. Interested in a pilot: 6-week POC with 4 reserved GPUs to validate latency and cost assumptions before full commit.
workshop_output_summary: Baseline capture completed. Steady-state QPS 120, median token length 150, peak multiplier x3 for 20-40m windows. Recommended reserved sizing: 8-12 A100-eq (config depends on model family + quantization). Suggested ops: enable prefix/KV caching for common prompts, configure burst autoscale pool, define model routing policy with degrade-to-quantized smaller family for cost emergencies.

- Model: permissive on open models; want Redwood guidance on quantized variants.
